name: Spinning Plates
description: Four boxes ride a turntable that spins 90° clockwise on every move.
howToPlay: Only the boxes at the bottom of the plate can be reached. Each tap pours that box's marbles AND spins the whole plate one quarter-turn clockwise — bringing a new color down into reach. Any tap counts as a move, so keep tapping to cycle every color out and sort them all!
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Spinning Plates
showcaseLevel.desc: Spin the turntable to reach every color
